draw: census: all 62 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact EXACTLY as given, convert to JSON with sorted keys (recursive), emit with no whitespace, and persist those exact bytes to runs/<runId>/p<i>-<leverId>/proposal_canon.json before hashing; then compute seed = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json) and verify mechanically that sha256sum proposal_canon.json reproduces seedHex. To re-derive: third party recomputes sha256 of the persisted proposal_canon.json bytes to obtain hProposal, then recomputes seed as SHA-256(hProposal + salt) where hProposal = 3e4f41abdfdd23819dbb5877e116e00571a5078b798e09f35cbac986c21121ae and salt = 5e67359e1a0bcfa28d99126cc93429a4e419f97c8e84baca761a409a7ed09e7d; the draw is deterministic in census mode: take every entry of census.json (N=62) in order as witnesses.
